title: M8 delegated package catalog and plans

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_list_package_sources
x-alcomd-tools.title: List registered package sources
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read package-source IDs and availability. Use these IDs to filter lists and select a version.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_search_packages
x-alcomd-tools.title: Search the package catalog
x-alcomd-tools.description: List visible packages, optionally restricted to a repository or evaluated against a registered project.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_get_package
x-alcomd-tools.title: Read package versions
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read metadata for a package, optionally selecting a version and source or checking project compatibility.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_plan_package_install
x-alcomd-tools.title: Review a package installation
x-alcomd-tools.description: Plan one compatible installation. Normally omit version_selector to use the Core recommendation. Show the complete plan and obtain confirmation before applying.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_plan_package_reinstall
x-alcomd-tools.title: Review a package reinstallation
x-alcomd-tools.description: Plan a reinstallation of the current locked version. Show the complete plan and obtain confirmation before applying.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_plan_package_changes
x-alcomd-tools.title: Review package changes
x-alcomd-tools.description: Plan installation, removal, upgrade, downgrade, resolution, reinstallation, or a bounded batch. For installation or upgrade, normally omit version_selector to use the Core recommendation. Review the original plan and obtain confirmation before applying.

version_selector.description: Omit to use the Core recommendation. Specify an exact version or range to constrain selection.
